prompts.register: How do I register for an event?
prompts.host: How can I host a workshop?
prompts.help: Where can I get platform help?

register.answer: To register, open the Events or Hackathons page, choose a card, and use the registration action. If the event requires an account, sign in first so Eventra can save your registration and check-in details.

suggest.answer: A good starting point is a workshop or beginner-friendly hackathon. Search by topic on the Events page, then compare format, date, tags, and location before registering.

host.answer: Organizers can create events from the dashboard after signing in. Add the event title, format, schedule, capacity, location or meeting details, then publish when the listing is ready.

help.answer: For platform questions, start with the FAQ. For account, registration, or technical problems, use Contact so the team has enough context to help.

knowledge.default: I can help with event registration, recommendations, hosting guidance, and platform support. Try asking about the event you want to attend or what kind of workshop you are looking for.

faq.title: Preguntas Frecuentes

faqQuestions.q1: How do I register for a hackathon or event?
faqQuestions.a1: Navigate to the Events page, select your desired hackathon or event, and click the Register button. Fill in the required details and submit your registration.
faqQuestions.q2: Can I participate in multiple events simultaneously?
faqQuestions.a2: Yes, you can register for and participate in multiple events, but be mindful of overlapping schedules.
faqQuestions.q3: How are points calculated on the leaderboard?
faqQuestions.a3: Points are awarded based on event participation, project submissions, pull requests merged, and community engagement.
faqQuestions.q4: Is there a fee for hosting events?
faqQuestions.a4: Basic event hosting is free. Premium features may require a subscription.
faqQuestions.q5: How do I reset my password?
faqQuestions.a5: Go to your Profile Settings, click on Security, and select Change Password. Follow the prompts to reset it.
faqQuestions.q6: What should I do if I encounter a bug?
faqQuestions.a6: Report it via the Contact Us page or open a GitHub issue with detailed steps to reproduce.
faqQuestions.q7: Can I collaborate with other users?
faqQuestions.a7: Yes, you can form teams, collaborate on projects, and communicate via integrated discussion forums.
faqQuestions.q8: How do I track my progress?
faqQuestions.a8: Your dashboard and achievements page provide detailed analytics on your participation and contributions.
faqQuestions.q9: Are there rewards for top contributors?
faqQuestions.a9: Top contributors receive badges, certificates, and recognition on the leaderboard and community channels.
faqQuestions.a10: You can reach us through the Contact Us page, email, or our community Discord server.

1.question: ¿Cómo me registro en un evento o hackatón?
1.answer: Navegue a la página de Eventos o Hackatones, encuentre el que desea y haga clic en el botón Registrarse. Complete los detalles requeridos y envíe su registro.

2.question: ¿Cómo envío un proyecto?
2.answer: Vaya a la sección de Proyectos, haga clic en Enviar Proyecto y complete los detalles requeridos, incluido el título, la descripción y el enlace al repositorio de su proyecto.

3.question: ¿Cómo me uno a un hackatón?
3.answer: Navegue por la página de Hackatones y haga clic en Unirse en cualquier hackatón abierto. Puede participar solo o como parte de un equipo.

4.question: ¿Cómo se calcula la puntuación del marcador?
4.answer: Las puntuaciones se basan en sus contribuciones, participación en eventos, solicitudes de incorporación de cambios fusionadas y envíos de proyectos en la plataforma.

5.question: ¿Cómo contribuyo a Eventra como proyecto de código abierto?
5.answer: Consulte la página de Guía de Colaboradores para obtener instrucciones detalladas sobre cómo configurar el proyecto localmente, elegir problemas y enviar solicitudes de incorporación de cambios.
